---
title: "List"
subtitle: "Visualise a list and its index pointers"
---

## Sandbox

- variable names starting with `p` and having the type `int` will be considered as pointers. E.x. `p0`, `pleft` etc
- only array with name `arr` will be visualised. 

```{=html}
<div class="panel-grid panel-grid--list">
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="list-viz"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="list-editor"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { PythonEditorInput } from "./js/utils/python-editor-input.js";
import { mountListViz, listStarterCode } from "./js/list-viz.js";

listEditor = PythonEditorInput.mountPlayable(
  document.querySelector("#list-editor"),
  {
    heading: "Python",
    defaultCode: listStarterCode,
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
listViz = mountListViz(document.querySelector("#list-viz"), {
  editor: listEditor,
})
```
